## Story
8607-5358-5d67-4987

## Context
Insert the P1 self-contained dso.workflow shim block into plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh. The shim intercepts key==dso.workflow, performs its own config resolution, maps legacy keys to canonical values, emits a deprecation warning for legacy keys, and exits — leaving all 34 existing callers of read-config.sh completely unaffected.

## Task Classification
testing_mode: UPDATE

## File to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh — insert shim block after arg-parsing block (~line 34), before general config_file resolution block (~line 42)

## Shim Block to Insert
```bash
if [[ "$key" == "dso.workflow" ]]; then
    _wf_config="$config_file"
    if [[ -z "$_wf_config" ]]; then
        if [[ -n "${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE:-}" ]]; then
            _wf_config="${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE}"
        else
            _git_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            [[ -n "$_git_root" && -f "$_git_root/.claude/dso-config.conf" ]] && _wf_config="$_git_root/.claude/dso-config.conf"
        fi
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "${_wf_config:-}" ]]; then
        echo "DSO: No .claude/dso-config.conf found. Run /dso:onboarding to configure dso.workflow." >&2; exit 1
    fi
    _canonical=$(grep -m1 "^dso\.workflow=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    [[ -n "$_canonical" ]] && { printf '%s' "$_canonical"; exit 0; }
    _merge=$(grep -m1 "^merge\.strategy=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    _enforce=$(grep -m1 "^enforcement\.strategy=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    [[ -z "${DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET:-}" ]] && echo "DSO deprecation: merge.strategy/enforcement.strategy are deprecated. Set dso.workflow=ci-pr|local" >&2
    [[ "$_merge" == "pr" && "$_enforce" == "ci" ]] && printf '%s' "ci-pr" || printf '%s' "local"
    exit 0
fi
```

## Placement Rule
Insert AFTER the block ending with:
  key="$arg1"; config_file="${2:-}"
AND BEFORE the block starting with:
  if [[ -z "$config_file" ]]; then

This ensures the shim intercepts before the general resolution block (which has its own exit 0 for missing config).

## Behavioral Requirements
- dso.workflow=ci-pr in config → returns ci-pr, exit 0
- dso.workflow=local in config → returns local, exit 0
- merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci (legacy, no dso.workflow) → ci-pr, exit 0, stderr deprecation warning
- Any other legacy combination → local, exit 0, stderr deprecation warning
- DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1 → suppresses deprecation warning (stdout unchanged)
- Missing config file → exit 1, stderr contains 'onboarding'
- All other key reads (not dso.workflow): existing behavior UNCHANGED

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 7 tests from Task 5f3e-6f1f-8054-4763 now PASS (GREEN)
- All pre-existing tests in test-read-config.sh still pass
- bash tests/run-all.sh passes (full suite green)
- Shim positioned after arg-parsing, before general config_file resolution
- shellcheck passes on modified read-config.sh
